title: TheySix server refresh
summary: Refined server branding, player visibility, chat formatting, and staff tools.
description: Updated the TheySix server configuration with its public domains, a full player list that respects hide states, rank-colored chat names, and refreshed staff tooling. Retired glow and tag integrations were removed from active configuration, while the Halloween event remains historical.

body.text: Updated server displays to use play.theysix.tech, theysix.tech, and events.theysix.tech/vote. The TAB list now supports the full player list and respects TSHide visibility states.
Chat formatting now carries the player's rank color through the separator and username. The TAB rank display keeps the rank and username free of an extra separator.
Added TSStaff's read-only /update overview for checking plugin releases. Removed retired glow and tag displays and updated vote placeholders to use DankVotes.
The Halloween event is no longer part of the active server configuration. Its historical files remain archived, and no replacement /spawn destination has been assigned.
